title: Breakout: touch + bug fix
prompt:
The attached ZIP is an existing keyboard-only Breakout (index.html, src/game.js, README.md) imported as the starting point. Two jobs. (1) Bug report: 'the ball falls straight through the right half of the paddle and I lose a life' - reproduce it with Game.debug.setBall above the right half moving down, find the root cause in the paddle collision code and fix it; the left half, both ends (which deflect the ball outward) and balls passing beside the paddle must keep behaving correctly. (2) Touch controls: while a finger is down the paddle centre follows its x (clamped); a tap (released within 250 ms, moved less than 10 px) launches the ball; the canvas gets CSS touch-action: none and the handlers call preventDefault. Keep keyboard controls, bricks, scoring and the API unchanged.

Contract (window.Game; implement exactly):
- Game.start(): new game from any phase; phase becomes 'play'
- Game.getState(): {phase:'menu'|'play'|'over', score, lives, won, width:480, height:640, paddleX, paddleW, ballX, ballY, ballVX, ballVY, ballAttached, bricks, brickRects}
- Game.setSeed(n): seed the PRNG behind all randomness (applies at the next start())
- Game.step(n): advance exactly n fixed 1/60 s ticks synchronously
- Game.input.press(name): unchanged
- Game.input.release(name): unchanged
- Game.input.action(): unchanged
- Game.debug.setBall(x, y, vx, vy): unchanged
- Game.debug.keepBricks(n): unchanged

Acceptance (checked by Kyora Bench browser tests): paddle collision fixed across the whole paddle with no regressions; drag and tap controls; no page scrolling.
